subdomain.name: Telemetry Ingestion & Processing
subdomain.capability: Continuous high-throughput ingestion of raw 1Hz sensor payloads, physical metric validation, out-of-order reconciliation, and windowed buffering for streaming analytics (PulseStream Engine).
subdomain.why_distinct: Owns its own language (device vs ingress time, reorder window, backpressure), rules (sensor metric boundaries, 60s reorder, append-only revisions) and cadence (1Hz bursts); described as the single core domain of the engine.

ubiquitous_language.definition: Individual 1Hz data point (heart rate, power, cadence, ground contact time, respiration, swim stroke).
Raw payload received from an IoT edge device, bike computer or wearable, carrying one or more samples.
Time at which the packet arrived at the engine; never used for chronological ordering.
Device-generated epoch timestamp that determines chronological position of a sample.
Physical physiological/mechanical limits per metric (e.g. HR 30-240 BPM, Power 0-2500W, Cadence 0-220 RPM, Swim pace >45 s/100m).
Status flag tagged on a sample violating a Sensor Metric Boundary; the payload is retained.
60-second tolerance within which late packets are re-indexed by t_device.
Demand-driven flow control at the ingestion entry point allowing burst loads with no blocking I/O.
Appended record representing a correction or backfilled frame; originals are never modified.

bounded_contexts.name: Telemetry Sample Ingestion
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Accept raw ingress packets under backpressure, validate each sample against sensor metric boundaries and flag failures.
invariants: Every sample is validated against its Sensor Metric Boundary before downstream propagation
Invalid samples are flagged VALIDATION_FAILED and never dropped
Ingestion entry point performs zero blocking I/O and applies backpressure

bounded_contexts.name: Backfill Reordering & Windowing
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Re-index late samples chronologically by t_device within the 60s window and buffer windowed streams for streaming analytics.
invariants: Ordering is based on t_device, never t_ingress
Packets delayed up to 60 seconds are re-indexed into correct chronological position
source_of_truth: Chronological order of samples within the window

bounded_contexts.name: Telemetry Event Log
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Append-only storage of raw time-series records and revisions for auditability.
invariants: Raw records are strictly append-only; corrections and backfills append new revisions
source_of_truth: Raw time-series records and their revision history

assumptions.item: Description names a single domain; split into three contexts by distinct rule ownership (validation, ordering, immutability).
assumptions.impact_on_boundaries: Could collapse into one context if team treats them as one model.

assumptions.item: Samples later than the 60s window: handling unspecified (likely appended as correction revisions).
assumptions.impact_on_boundaries: Determines whether Event Log or Reordering owns late-arrival policy.

assumptions.item: Storage technology and downstream event stream consumers are outside scope; platform analytics treated as external.
